svg.title: Different models. One accountable project.
svg.desc: Cloud specialists and models you run can contribute to the same work—without owning the final decision. Conceptual CWO diagram showing model options, not a qualified support matrix or an observed execution trace.
svg.text: Cloud specialists and models you run can contribute to the same work—without owning the final decision.
